description: Room air-conditioner capacity using the ENERGY STAR sizing chart and its adjustments for sun, occupants and kitchens. Formula: Base BTU from the ENERGY STAR area chart; −10% heavily shaded, +10% very sunny, +600 BTU per person above 2, +4,000 BTU for a kitchen.

kitchen.description: Used as kitchen; default 0; one of 0 = No, 1 = Yes (+4,000 BTU)

name: calc_ac_btu
title: Room AC BTU Calculator (ENERGY STAR Sizing)
